card.name: Modifiers right before the word dose
card.fires_on: The last word or word part of a dose descriptor just before the noun "dose", such as a unit, route, frequency or regimen word. It is common after "single" or a number with a unit.

modes.label: Unit or route before dose
modes.description: A measure or route word that ends right before "dose".

modes.label: Frequency or regimen word
modes.description: A word like daily, weekly or regimen that directly precedes "dose".
modes.example: administered as a single<< daily>> dose at

modes.label: Route word split mid-word
modes.description: Partway through a route word like intravenous or intramuscular before "dose".
modes.example: A single intr<<avenous>> dose not exceeding 100 mg

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a noun like sentence, note, term or word that completes the phrase, with dose-like nouns fitting this slot.
card.plain: It fires on the descriptor just before the word "dose", such as "single 40-mg" or "once-weekly".
